_comment: The single home for tunable process values (workflow-commands spec). Every /aio:* command reads these from here; no command or doc may hardcode them. Raising wipLimit requires an ADR (DEC-017).
_holdLabelComment: The hold: a person must act before anything else does. Reserved constant, identical everywhere, never renamed per-repository. It is NOT a lifecycle state, so it never joins lifecycleLabels — an issue carries the hold alongside exactly one status:* label. Provisioned once by hand like the nine; no command invents it. Every mutating /aio:* command refuses while it is on, and nothing in this repository ever removes it — clearing is a person's act, always.
